_comment: THE defaults for the scripts in this folder -- the scripts hardcode none of these. Edit this file and run with NO args. A CLI flag/positional is optional and overrides the matching key for that one run only; no script ever writes this file. Relative paths are resolved against the qcar_testbed_integration/ root. password: null = use SSH keys (never store a real password here). Keys prefixed cross_check_* belong to cross_check_vicon_labeling.py, the rest to pull_qcar_bags.py.
